title: Explore demo data from an instrumented app

blocks.content: You don't need an instrumented app to see what one looks like in Grafana Cloud. The **Demo Data Dashboards** app installs the telemetry of QuickPizza, a fictional pizza service, into hosted data sources that are free to use and don't count toward your usage. This guide installs the demo and runs a first query against its data.
Expand **More apps** in the main menu, then open **Demo Data Dashboards**.
Click **Install the Quick Pizza SRE demo**. This deploys the demo data sources and dashboards, then refreshes the page.
QuickPizza's telemetry is now in your stack: a **QuickPizza** dashboards folder, plus data sources for its metrics, logs, and traces.
Open the picker and choose **grafanacloud-play-prom**. It holds the demo's metrics.
blocks.tooltip: Every query runs against one of your connected data stores. This picker chooses which one.

blocks.content: The query editor has two modes. Switch to **Code** mode so you can type the query directly. If **Code** is already selected, this changes nothing.
In the query field, enter `quickpizza_server_http_requests_total`. It counts every request QuickPizza's server has handled.
Click **Run query**. The rows coming back are real telemetry from a running, instrumented app.
You queried the metrics of an instrumented app without instrumenting anything yourself.

The dashboards in the **QuickPizza** folder are built on these same data sources, and you can influence the numbers by visiting the live site at [quickpizza.grafana.fun](https://quickpizza.grafana.fun/). When you have an app of your own to instrument, everything you saw here works the same way on your data.
